tests.name: provisional flag from dq-7 is present on the draft output

tests.action: Run the draft step on the unit
tests.expected: The draft output's flags field contains the provisional marker referencing dq-7

tests.name: provisional flag survives the check step
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional: step 2 (check)

tests.action: Run the check step, including the case where the check passes cleanly
tests.expected: The check output's flags field still contains the dq-7 provisional marker; a passed check does not clear it

tests.name: provisional flag survives bundling
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional: step 3 (bundle)
tests.setup: Checked output carrying the dq-7 flag
tests.expected: The bundle output's flags field contains the dq-7 provisional marker

tests.name: bundle mixing provisional and verified units is flagged provisional
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional: a unit downstream of a provisional decision carries the flag
tests.setup: Two checked units, one built on dq-7 (flagged), one built on a confirmed decision (no flag)
tests.expected: The bundle carries the dq-7 provisional flag; the flag is not dropped by merging with an unflagged unit

tests.name: end-to-end chain: flag present after every step
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional through every step
tests.setup: Unit built on dq-7; stubs for model calls
tests.action: Run draft, check, bundle in sequence and read each step's output file
tests.expected: All three outputs carry the dq-7 provisional flag

tests.name: step that receives a flagged input but writes empty flags is refused
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional: a step cannot drop the flag
tests.setup: A step implementation stub that writes its output with flags: []
tests.action: Run the pipeline's flag-propagation check on that step's output
tests.expected: The run fails or the output is rejected; the test fails if an unflagged output downstream of dq-7 is accepted

tests.name: unit not built on any provisional decision carries no provisional flag
tests.rule: Control: the flag marks only units downstream of a provisional decision
tests.setup: Unit built only on confirmed decisions
tests.expected: No provisional flag in any output

spec_findings: The spec does not say what happens to the flag when dq-7 is later confirmed by its owner (re-run, re-stamp, or leave the old outputs flagged)
The spec does not say whether a reviewer or check step is ever allowed to clear the flag; the tests assume it is not
covered: Flag present after draft, check and bundle
Flag survives a clean check and merging with unflagged units
A step that drops the flag is caught
not_covered: Behaviour after dq-7 is confirmed or reversed (spec silent)
Reports or displays rendering the flag to people
actions_now: Write property tests that follow a dq-7 unit through draft, check and bundle with stubbed model calls and assert the flag at every step, plus a negative test for a step that drops it; send the spec owner the question about confirmation.

defects: The test is nondeterministic: it reads the real clock twice and relies on setTimeout precision, so it fails when timer drift lands on the boundary. If the session code reads Date.now directly with no clock seam, the implementer needs to add one (or the test uses fake timers that mock Date)
covered: Expiry just before and at the 15-minute boundary, deterministically
not_covered: Sliding expiry behaviour (spec silent)
actions_now: Decline retry(3): a flaky test is a failing test until its cause is found. Replace the real-time wait with a fixed or fake clock and boundary checks, and report the cause to the tech lead.

spec_findings: The binding does not say who may perform draft to reviewed, or whether approved/published can be reverted and by whom
setStatus takes actor as a parameter; the design does not say how the actor's identity is established, so an agent could pass 'owner'
covered: Every agent role and the coordinator attempting approved and published, including skipping steps

Owner control path

Actor spoofing, if actor identity is not established outside the caller
escalate_reason: If actor is a caller-supplied argument with no verified identity, the property that an agent cannot perform the owner's transition cannot be proven with the current design; raise with the architect/spec owner.
